target_customer: Latino immigrants in the US and their families in Latin America
problem: Remittances are expensive and slow and Latino immigrants are poorly served by banks.
business_model: Fintech app: account and card fees, low-fee remittances, FX on stablecoin rails

founders.name: Piero del Risco
prior_employers: Scotiabank (head of digital banking, Caribbean and Central America)
founders.background_notes: Led a 130+ person team rebuilding digital banking for 2M customers in 11 countries (YC).

founders.name: Luis Peña
founders.background_notes: 10+ years building software; products reached 1.5M users (YC).

technical_complexity.rationale: Embedded wallets, stablecoin on/off ramps and bank partnerships need compliance and integrations but rely on existing providers.

defensibility.rationale: Money-transmitter licensing and a Latino-focused community help, but remittance apps and stablecoin rails are widely accessible.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action against Pana specifically found.

market_need_then: Large US-Latin America remittance flows and fee pain; a Bloomberg Linea Aug 2022 piece covers the company's YC-era pitch.

branding.community_and_virality: Group chats for lending and borrowing are a product feature; no fan or press evidence on brand.

brand_strength.rationale: Short friendly word with a Spanish-language audience fit, but no source documents its effect.

outcome_analysis: Pana is a Miami neobank for Latinos built around stablecoins, with 14 staff and still active. A Privy post (undated) cites 150,000 users and 7.2M dollars of monthly volume, and the company joined Visa Fintech Fast Track in 2026 and launched a card in Dec 2025. Funding is unclear; conflicting aggregator figures prevent a firm assessment.
notes: Seed amount conflicts: 2.6M (one profile) vs 500K (Seedtable), unverified; not recorded. A Bloomberg Linea interview reportedly mentions a Dominican angel before YC. Felix and other remittance competitors found only in undated or 2024-25 sources, so list left empty. Name origin not stated in sources found. Update: a seed round dated 2022-07 is now recorded. Amount left null because sources conflict: Yespress and Bouncewatch say 2.6M, Seedtable and CB Insights say about 500K. All are databases or profiles, no press release found.
